documents.title: Example: commissioners court minutes, industrial reuse item
documents.text: Item 7. Staff summarized a request to reuse former industrial land for a data center campus of about 300 MW. A resident said "The jobs would help Rockdale, and the land has been empty for years." Another resident said "I worry about the water table, our wells are already low." A business owner said "We support this if the road repairs are paid for." No action was taken; the item returns for a hearing.

documents.title: Example: commissioners court, request for a study of data center rules
documents.text: Residents asked the court to study rules for data centers. A resident said "The power lines already cross my land and now they want gas turbines too." Another said "Hail took my roof last year; who pays when this plant floods the creek?" A business owner said "These projects pay school taxes we badly need." The court directed staff to study a possible pause on new large-load permits.
